# -*- Mode: Makefile for CI checks -*-
#
# Copyright (C) 2019--2026 Olaf Bergmann <bergmann@tzi.org> and others

# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
#
# This file is part of the CoAP library libcoap. Please see README for terms
# of use.

top_builddir?=../..
top_srcdir?=../..
OUT?=.
libcoap?=libcoap-3-openssl
WARNING_CFLAGS?=-pedantic -Wall -Wcast-qual -Wextra -Wformat-security -Winline -Wmissing-declarations -Wmissing-prototypes -Wnested-externs -Wpointer-arith -Wshadow -Wstrict-prototypes -Wswitch-default -Wswitch-enum -Wunused -Wwrite-strings  -Wunused-result -gdwarf-4
DTLS_CFLAGS?=
DTLS_LIBS?=-lssl -lcrypto
CPPFLAGS=-I$(top_builddir)/include -I$(top_srcdir)/include -I$(top_srcdir)
CFLAGS+=$(WARNING_CFLAGS) $(DTLS_CFLAGS) -std=c99
CFLAGS+=-Wno-missing-prototypes -Wno-missing-declarations

SOURCES:=$(wildcard *_target.c)
OBJECTS:= $(patsubst %.c, $(OUT)/%.o, $(SOURCES))
PROGRAMS:=$(patsubst %_target.o, %_fuzzer, $(OBJECTS))

.PHONY: all check

all: $(OUT)/coap_fuzz_helper.a $(PROGRAMS)

$(OUT)/%.o: %.c
        $(CC) $(CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) $(EXTRA_CFLAGS) -c $^ -o $@

$(OUT)/coap_fuzz_helper.a: $(OUT)/coap_fuzz_helper.o
        $(AR) rcs $@ $^

%_fuzzer: %_target.o $(OUT)/coap_fuzz_helper.a
        $(LINK.cc) $(CXXFLAGS) $^ $(top_builddir)/.libs/$(libcoap).a $(LDFLAGS) $(LDLIBS) $(DTLS_LIBS) -o $@
        @if [ -d "$(top_srcdir)/tests/oss-fuzz/$(notdir $*)_seed_corpus" ]; then \
                echo "Found seed corpus for $@, creating zip..."; \
                cd $(top_srcdir)/tests/oss-fuzz && zip -rj $@_seed_corpus.zip $(notdir $*)_seed_corpus/; \
        fi

check: $(OBJECTS)

clean:
        @-$(RM) -f $(OBJECTS) $(PROGRAMS) $(OUT)/coap_fuzz_helper.o $(OUT)/coap_fuzz_helper.a
